name: Timezone Converter
summary: One moment, every timezone you keep
description:
Timezone Converter turns one moment into every timezone you care about. Type it the way you say it — “3pm New York”, “tomorrow 9:30 Berlin”, “mon 10 utc+5” — or pick it, and read it in each of your zones at once, with the day shift and the offset from your source zone on every row.

Keep a zone list for the people you schedule with; open on the current time, so it doubles as a world clock until you move the moment. Copy any row straight to the pasteboard for the chat where the meeting is being arranged.
